effect.name: GM Chromatic Grain
effect.desc: Luma-aware RGB film grain with stable per-channel sampling.
effect.shader: float pnkjRand(vec2 p){return fract(sin(dot(p,vec2(12.9898,78.233)))*43758.5453);}void main(){vec2 u=acScreenNorm;vec4 s=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,u);vec2 texSize=max(inputImg.size,vec2(1.0));vec2 p=floor(u*texSize/max(size,0.5))+floor(phase);float g=pnkjRand(p)-0.5;vec3 cg=vec3(pnkjRand(p+1.7),pnkjRand(p+8.3),pnkjRand(p+19.1))-0.5;float l=1.0-0.55*dot(s.rgb,vec3(0.2126,0.7152,0.0722));vec3 noise=mix(vec3(g),cg,clamp(chroma,0.0,1.0))*amount*l;gl_FragColor=vec4(clamp(s.rgb+noise,0.0,1.0),s.a);}
